sessions.title: Why Your Vector Query is Slow: Inside Look to Oracle Optimizer
sessions.description: Vector search is transforming how applications retrieve and reason over data, but delivering high-performance AI-powered retrieval requires much more than a new index type. The Oracle Optimizer continues to evolve, recognizing vector access paths, estimating costs, and generating execution plans that seamlessly combine vector similarity search with traditional relational operations. Designed for developers and database specialists, this session explores how Oracle AI Database extends its cost-based optimization framework to support vector indexes and hybrid AI workloads.

sessions.title: From Embeddings to Agent Context: Build on Autonomous AI Vector Database
sessions.description: In this hands-on lab, you’ll learn techniques for building vector-powered AI applications using Oracle Autonomous AI Vector Database. You’ll import an ONNX embedding model, load sample data, generate embeddings, perform semantic similarity searches, and combine semantic retrieval with metadata filters.
